_about: Merge the "What came with the money" research (27 Nov 2026) into data/influence_found.json.

entries.summary: Siemens Österreich and Ars Electronica ran the Siemens Artist in Residence programme from 2001, in which artists made works at the Ars Electronica Futurelab, later shown at the Siemens_artLab in Vienna in 2005.

Siemens Smart Infrastructure supplied the access control, fire protection and intruder detection for the 2021 extension, and developed with the museum a sensor that sounds a warning when someone nears an artwork.
The free public screenings of festival operas and concerts on the Kapitelplatz carry its name, the Siemens Fest>Spiel>Nächte, since 2002, with about 70,000 visitors a year.
Its Simcenter Digital Twin software was used in the “Sound of Science” simulation, which replicates the acoustics of the festival halls digitally.

In August 2020 Fridays for Future Salzburg staged a die-in outside the Festspielhaus. Its statement named Siemens among the sponsors and said the festival gives them a platform to improve their image.
An exclusive NIGO x Nike Air Force 1 launch was held at the museum when its exhibition NIGO: From Japan with Love opened.
The museum carries the group's name: its Chinese name, 华侨城当代艺术中心, means OCT Contemporary Art Center.
The museum's art and research library is named the Wipro Library. The Wipro Foundation grant supported construction of the museum building, which opened in February 2023.
The grant covers visits by Wipro's customers to the museum as part of Wipro's customer relationship work.
Its Benefactor membership ($10,000+) brings free admission for all its employees, two Executive Memberships, an invitation to the annual Director's Dinner and custom volunteer opportunities.
The 2026 master sponsorship gives InfinitePay signage in the museum's three buildings, exclusive guided tours, and events and tickets for its guests and staff.
Novartis International AG backed Sculpture on the Move 1946 to 2016, the opening special exhibition of the museum's new building, April to September 2016.
IRIS+, the talking assistant added to the main exhibition in December 2017, runs on IBM Watson and is hosted on the IBM Cloud.
Listed in the Leadership Circle, the $100,000 Leader tier, which brings priority consideration for MOWAA leadership roles, subcommittees and advisory councils, plus all Friends of MOWAA benefits.
Sangita Jindal, chair of the JSW Foundation, sits on the Khoj board as an advisor.

Nature in Action, a 2026 Kingston Creative mural commission at the Abilities Foundation on Constant Spring Road, is made in partnership with the Digicel Foundation as the centrepiece of a rain garden project.
Its foundation funds the Chaire Création & Innovation held by conductor Esa-Pekka Salonen in 2026-2027, under a three-season deal of April 2026 that made it principal patron.
Démos, the Philharmonie's orchestra programme for children, has had the foundation as patron since it began, and the foundation backs La Balise, the house radio for 15 to 25 year olds.
Through Mécénat Musical Société Générale it was grand mécène of the visiting international orchestras programme for the 2015, 2015/2016 and 2016/2017 seasons.
Helped pay for the Modern Military Aviation gallery, where the museum thanks it with General Atomics among the gallery's supporters.
Is named among the leadership donors to the renovation of the museum's building on the National Mall.
It sponsored the festival's 2025 Fashion Show.
María Luisa Ferré Rangel chairs the board of trustees (Junta de Síndicos) of the museum and of the Fundación Luis A. Ferré, a post she has held for 33 years.
Dulux paint coloured the walls of the 2016 show Painting. More Painting, credited as exhibition colours by Dulux in Ticking Flat Acrylic and White Flat Acrylic.
AkzoNobel, the Biennale's Color Partner for its 2020 edition, unveiled its 2020 Color of the Year, Tranquil Dawn, with the Lahore Biennale at the Wazir Khan Baradari.
Members of the Cercle Louvre-Lens, where Bouygues Bâtiment Nord-Est is a partner member, get private visits of the Galerie du temps, exhibitions and backstage, and museum spaces for their own events.
Cercle Louvre-Lens gifts run through the French mécénat deduction: the company deducts 60% of the gift from its tax, up to 0.5% of turnover.
The Whitney's Meatpacking District home is named the Leonard A. Lauder Building, announced in April 2016 when he received the first Whitney Collection Award.
Leonard Lauder was a Whitney trustee from 1977 to 2011 and became Chairman Emeritus.
Judy and Leonard Lauder were honorary co-chairs of the 2023 Whitney Gala, held at the museum on 16 May 2023.
In 2021 Freelands Foundation awarded Wysing £500,000 for the Syllabus, a ten year development programme for ten artists from under-represented backgrounds.
Quartz Reef is the gallery's preferred vineyard and wine supplier, named with its contact details on the gallery's venue hire page.
In 2021 the museum dressed 12 store windows at Plaza del Caribe with printed works from its collection and ran art workshops there and at Plaza Las Américas, malls of the Empresas Fonalledas group.
Award winners at the 2016 festival received Canon equipment: an EOS 5D Mark III camera and two Pixma printers with paper and ink.
The Canon Storytelling Workshop, part of Canon's Miraisha sustainability programme, was held at the African Artists' Foundation in Lagos on 25 October 2018, led by Georgina Goodwin.
As a product sponsor, Coca-Cola has its drinks placed in the concert hall's catering facilities.
Since the 2022/23 edition, the Africa and diaspora winner of the Access ART X Prize, sponsored by Access Bank's parent Access Corporation, takes a residency at G.A.S. in Lagos.

Under its five year Principal Partner deal of 2021, the Biennale agreed to bring commissioned artworks, hosted exhibitions and workshops to Mirvac's residential, office, retail and build to rent properties through 2026.
Some of Mirvac's residential, office and retail customers attended three previews held before the 2024 Biennale, Ten Thousand Suns, opened.
Quark's 2023 sustainability report says money from its onboard guest auctions supported repairs and maintenance on the historic buildings of the UK Antarctic Heritage Trust, which runs Port Lockroy.
The festival showed "Prix Pictet Celebrates its Laureates" at La Croisière in 2018, an exhibition produced by the Prix Pictet in collaboration with the Pictet Group.
"Prix Pictet: a retrospective" ran at the Magasin Électrique in 2014, coproduced by the Prix Pictet and the festival.
Corporate partners, Shiseido among the main ones, are invited to special previews and events and receive annual invitation tickets.
A gallery at MAP bears the foundation's name: the Infosys Foundation Gallery, where the 2025 to 2026 annual report records a ten day show of Putul dolls from West Bengal.
Paris Neilson, a trustee of the Neilson Foundation, sat on the Biennale's board from 2011 and was still on it in 2016.
Leadership Circle donors, the level Azura is listed at, get priority consideration for MOWAA subcommittees and advisory councils, plus Friends access to museum events.

Mphasis granted MAP INR 10 crore over five years for accessibility: barrier-free building work and interiors, workshops for people with disabilities, accessible exhibitions and website, and an Inclusion Officer.
Bell is credited among the donors who made the Michal and Renata Hornstein Pavilion for Peace possible. The pavilion opened in 2016.
Since 2019 Megacable, as MEGA, has supplied the high-speed internet at festival venues that carries the transmission of performances.
Michael R. Bloomberg hosted the Serpentine Summer Party in Kensington Gardens on 23 June 2026 with the gallery's chief executive and artistic director.

Mark Getty received an honorary knighthood in January 2016 for services to the arts and philanthropy. The gallery's release said the award recognised in particular his leadership of and support for the National Gallery.
Mark Getty was a trustee from September 1999 and chaired the Board of Trustees from August 2009 to August 2015.
The gallery commissioned a bronze bust of Sir Paul Getty from Gerald Laing, made in 1996, to acknowledge his donation. It stands in the Main Vestibule.

Thomas Girst, BMW Group's head of cultural communication, told taz in March 2012, in an interview on the BMW Guggenheim Lab, that BMW's cultural work is not altruistic and is of course also about reputation.
Fridays for Future Salzburg staged a die-in at the first Jedermann performance in July 2022 with a banner accusing Audi of greenwashing, objecting to Audi as festival sponsor.
Fridays for Future Salzburg protested at the Cosi fan tutte premiere in August 2020. It named Audi among the sponsors and said the festival gives such industries a platform to improve their image.

Chung Euisun, Hyundai Motor Group's executive chair, received an honorary CBE in November 2023 for contributions to the arts, culture and eco-friendly mobility. The Korea Times report noted Hyundai's long sponsorship of Tate Modern.
Penny Pritzker chaired the museum's board from 1996 to 1999 and is a life member of the Board of Trustees.

Salvador García Ruiz, director of corporate affairs and sustainability at Telefónica, sits on the theatre's Board of Protectors, which is made up of senior managers of its associate, sponsor and patron companies.

An open letter in Mediapart in October 2014, signed by Georges Didi-Huberman, Giorgio Agamben and others, opposed celebrating the foundation's opening. It said such groups use art as a display and their patrons are speculators.
President François Hollande inaugurated the Fondation Louis Vuitton on 20 October 2014, welcomed by Bernard Arnault and his wife.
Christine Buhl Andersen, the Glyptotek's director, was appointed chair of the New Carlsberg Foundation in August 2019. The foundation said that in that role she would also chair the museum's board.
Jacob Rothschild chaired the National Gallery's trustees from 1985.
Hannah Rothschild chaired the National Gallery's trustees from August 2015 to September 2019, the first woman to do so. The director Gabriele Finaldi thanked her for her "commitment and generosity".
Lord Rothschild sat on the Courtauld's Governing Board from June 2002 to July 2007. The Courtauld's tribute in 2024 called him "tremendously generous" to it.
Francesca Lavazza was elected to the Solomon R. Guggenheim Foundation's Board of Trustees. She said in March 2017 that the invitation came "after two years of exhibition partnerships".
MoMA named David Rockefeller honorary chairman in June 2005, a newly created position. The Art Newspaper noted his recent pledge to the museum.
David Rockefeller sat on MoMA's board of trustees from 1948 until his death in 2017 and was its chairman for several terms.

rockefellerbrothers.space_name: Lincoln Center for the Performing Arts

entries.summary: John D. Rockefeller III received a Special Tony Award in 1960 "for vision and leadership in creating the Lincoln Center".
The Kitchen honoured Jamie Singer Soros and Robert Soros at its Spring Gala on 22 May 2025, with Lucinda Childs and Wu Tsang. The gala page lists the two among its lead sponsors.
The King and Queen of Spain opened the building in February 2008.
Isidro Fainé, the foundation's chair, sits on the Prado's Royal Board of Trustees. A culture ministry order of April 2022 renewed his seat for five years.
Andrey Kostin, VTB's president and chairman, sat on the board of trustees of the Friends of the Russian Museum fund in 2018. The bank is a member of the fund.

Alain-Dominique Perrin, the former Cartier head who started the foundation, called it a work of communication born of marketing thinking. Thirty years on he said it gave Cartier priceless extra credibility (Carenews, July 2016).
George Weston, a trustee of the Garfield Weston Foundation, is a trustee of the British Museum. He was reappointed for a term that runs from July 2023 to March 2027.
Dame Theresa Sackler was a trustee of the V&A from 2011 to 2019, the museum said in October 2022 when it dropped the family name.
Mortimer D.A. Sackler sat on the Guggenheim's board of trustees for nearly 20 years and stepped down in 2018.
In October 2018 Chris Garrard of Culture Unstained said that by leaving the National Gallery Shell admitted it was a company with a badly damaged reputation that it needed to repair.
The museum gave its MCA Corporate Art Award to Citadel and Ken Griffin in 2018, for their impact on arts education in Chicago.
Griffin was one of two people honoured at the museum's Art of the Party gala in November 2024.

In November 2025 Dr Allen Gallagher of the University of Bath said deals like JTI's with the British Museum let the tobacco industry, whose products kill, use cultural institutions to improve its public image.
The Fossil Free Louvre campaign against Total's sponsorship said in 2017 that fossil fuel companies gain an appearance of respectability from their Louvre partnership.
Patrick Pouyanné, the chairman and chief executive of TotalEnergies, has sat on the board of the Institut du Monde Arabe since 2017.
The partnership of Morgan Stanley, Somerset House and The Courtauld won the Arts and Cultural Sponsorship category at the UK Sponsorship Awards 2023.

In August 2026 MASP gave Alfredo Setubal, chief executive of Itaúsa, the holding company that controls Itaú Unibanco, the title of honorary president. He had chaired the museum's council for the previous ten years.

ita.space_name: Museu de Arte Moderna de São Paulo

entries.summary: Alfredo Setubal, chief executive of Itaúsa, the holding company that controls Itaú Unibanco, was once a member of the museum's council, NeoFeed wrote in November 2024.
Leonard Blavatnik was knighted in June 2017 for "services to philanthropy". The Art Newspaper's report of the honour named his £5m gift to the V&A's Exhibition Road extension.

In January 2024 Barry Healy wrote in Red Spark that Perth artists had ended the public acceptance Chevron gained from the sponsorship. Anthony Collins said a board member told him the festival divested under pressure.

Glenbow appointed Chevron Canada a Fellow of the museum in 2018, the first organisation to receive the honour. Glenbow cited the four-decade partnership and the sponsorship of the Chevron Open Minds Museum School.
In October 2026 Nicole Regalado of We Are UltraViolet said MoMA was helping to repair Leon Black's reputation by keeping him on its board. Protesters near the museum called for his removal.

Several students and alumni called in the student newspaper for Black's name to be removed from the centre, The New York Times reported in February 2021 after his $158 million in payments to Epstein emerged.
The Studio Museum in Harlem gave the Ford Foundation an award at its gala on 24 October 2016. Darren Walker, then the foundation's president, accepted it.
President Emmanuel Macron and culture minister Rachida Dati toured the Grand Palais renovation site on 15 April 2024 in the presence of Bruno Pavlovsky, president of Chanel SAS.
The Fundació Joan Miró gave Fundación BBVA its bronze 'garrofa' in January 2025 for more than three decades of collaboration. Carlos Torres Vila, who chairs BBVA and its foundation, collected it.

The culture minister renewed BBVA chair Carlos Torres Vila as a member of the Prado's Real Patronato for five years in November 2025. The order says such members are named for contributions to the museum.
In December 2023 Doug Parr, policy director of Greenpeace UK, said of the £50 million deal that no cultural body should take fossil fuel companies' money in exchange for improving their public image.
In June 2019 Gary Hume, a judge of that year's BP Portrait Award, wrote to the gallery's director that the art world should stop helping the oil industry improve its public image.

In January 2026, after documents showed BP's role in the museum's STEM academy, Stuart Tannock of UCL said linking the BP brand with STEM education helps the company keep public acceptance of its business.

On 22 December 2014 the First-tier Tribunal, ordering Tate to disclose BP sponsorship sums, accepted that arts sponsorship can be understood as a way for BP to keep public acceptance of its operations.

Greta Thunberg pulled out of the August 2023 festival over Baillie Gifford's sponsorship. Her statement said the fossil fuel industry's greenwashing, sponsorship of cultural events included, helps it keep public acceptance of its business.

Olga Sánchez Rodríguez, president of Fundación AXA and chief executive of AXA España, joined the Prado's Real Patronato in 2019 as representative of a benefactor body. Her seat was renewed in July 2024.
Hans Rausing was knighted in the King's Birthday Honours of June 2025. The Art Newspaper's report of the honour named his support of projects at the National Gallery.
Michael Audain was made an Officer of the Order of Canada in 2009. The citation names his gifts to galleries and his service as president of the Vancouver Art Gallery and chair of its foundation.

A 2025 petition by Right Side Of History IRL says IMMA's listing of BNP Paribas as a Freud Circle sponsor makes the bank's practices look acceptable and wants it removed. The partnership ended in 2019.
The Bronx Museum gave the Deutsche Bank Americas Foundation its Corporate Philanthropic Award at its 2024 gala, for almost twenty years of support.
HSBC won the Award for Arts Sponsorship at the Hong Kong Arts Development Awards in June 2025, for its support as Lead Partner of M+ from 2022 to 2024.
Tata withdrew its funding in March 2019 and declined to say why. Arundhati Roy, a critic of Tata, then agreed to appear at the festival.
Allianz holds a seat on the theatre's board. Its chief executive Giacomo Campora was confirmed for the 2025 to 2028 term in February 2025.
Greenpeace activist and climate researcher Christine van der Horst carried a banner onto the catwalk at the festival's opening in May 2023 and said the sponsorship lets Equinor greenwash itself.
A petition started by the climate campaign Folk mot Fossilmakta says the sponsorship lets Equinor use art to polish its reputation and gives the oil company social acceptance.

In November 2023 Julie Forchhammer, co-founder of the Norwegian group Klimakultur, said Equinor's sponsorship of the Wonderlab gallery was part of a strategy of using culture to improve the company's image.
Culture Unstained said in July 2024 that Equinor had sponsored the children's Wonderlab gallery since 2016 to lift its brand in the UK. The museum did not renew the deal.

Emmanuel Mir's 2006 thesis at Düsseldorf University says the partnership was meant to spread a positive picture of E.ON as a corporate citizen, and that E.ON used the museum's rooms for representation.

nasher.space_name: Nasher Museum of Art at Duke

entries.summary: The Duke Alumni Association gave Raymond Nasher its Distinguished Alumni Award in 2004. The citation calls him the museum's guiding force and chief patron.
Stephen Bronfman was named a Commander of the Ordre de Montréal in 2026. The city's citation names his engagement with the Musée d'art contemporain and his lead in major fundraising campaigns.

Yoshiko Mori, a Mori Building director and the museum's chairperson emerita, received an honorary OBE in November 2025. The British Embassy cited the museum's support of UK artists under her stewardship.
The American Academy in Rome gave Miuccia Prada its McKim Medal in May 2010, citing her contributions to the visual arts as cofounder of the Fondazione Prada.
Independent Curators International named Miuccia Prada, head designer of Prada, for its 2013 Leo Award, acknowledging her work at Fondazione Prada.

Queen Sofía of Spain handed Eugenio López the Premio Iberoamericano de Mecenazgo in Madrid in February 2023 for his work for contemporary art. The report credits him with creating the Fundación Jumex and Museo Jumex.
Jérôme Pécresse, Rio Tinto's chief executive for aluminium, was one of four co-chairs of the museum's 2025 Museum Ball, its 65th.
The Walt Disney Company received a REDCAT Award at the 2013 REDCAT Gala, honoured as instrumental in founding and supporting CalArts and its REDCAT space.
In November 2020 Business and Arts South Africa gave Standard Bank and the festival its Long-Term Partnership Award for the Standard Bank Young Artist project, recognising 36 years of collaboration.

tisch.space_name: NYU Tisch School of the Arts

entries.summary: The school honoured the Tisch family at its 2016 gala for their contributions since the 1982 naming gift. Andrew, Jonathan and Steve Tisch accepted for the family.
The board elected Jonathan Tisch chair in April 2022, succeeding founding chair Daniel Doctoroff. A board member since 2013, he set up the centre's first commissioning fund with his wife Lizzie.
Sheikh Maktoum bin Mohammed, Deputy Ruler of Dubai, inaugurated the centre in November 2018. Fady Jameel, chairman and founder of Art Jameel, briefed him on it.
In March 2026 the writer Ycarim Melgaço called Vale's sponsorship of Inhotim a clear marketing move in Jornal Opção, and wrote that the company tries to change its image with culture and gardens.
In July 2015 David Aaker, vice chairman of the consultancy Prophet, wrote that the MoMA partnership improves Uniqlo's brand image.
In March 2025 the city of Santander honoured Emilio Botín, who chaired Banco Santander and the Fundación Botín, with a plaque in the square that bears his name, for projects such as the Centro Botín.
In February 2020 the J. Paul Getty Trust named Alice Walton for its Getty Medal. Its president James Cuno credited her philanthropy, and the announcement named her as founder of Crystal Bridges.
Alice Walton chaired the museum's board of directors in February 2020, when she also sat on the board of the Walton Family Foundation.
President Vladimir Putin took a private tour of GES-2 with Mikhelson in December 2021, days before it opened to the public (The Telegraph).
Soichiro Fukutake, former head of Benesse Corporation, received the Japan Foundation Award in 2026. The citation credits him with leading the development of Benesse Art Site Naoshima.
Soichiro Fukutake received Japan's Montblanc de la Culture Arts Patronage Award in July 2012. The jury named his founding of Benesse Art Site Naoshima as the reason (AFPBB News).
MoMA PS1 held its benefit gala in honour of Agnes Gund in May 2022 (Avenue Magazine).
Agnes Gund was chairman of the PS1 board of directors in June 2017 (W Magazine).
John Sainsbury and his brothers Simon and Tim escorted the Queen through the opening ceremony of the Sainsbury Wing in July 1991 (The Art Newspaper, 2022).
The museum gave Northern Trust its 2022 Arts Philanthropy Award at the Visionary luncheon, accepted by chairman and chief executive Michael O'Grady. The bank has supported the MCA since 1975.
Michael O'Grady of Northern Trust chaired the museum's board of trustees from 2018 to 2022 and then became its vice chairman.
France named Oya Eczacıbaşı to the Légion d'honneur in March 2011. The reasons NTV reported included creating a meeting point at Istanbul Modern.
Writing in soL in November 2025, Osman Gece named Eczacıbaşı's İKSV among institutions that he said improve the image of big business and produce soft power through culture.

hearst.space_name: Lincoln Center for the Performing Arts

entries.summary: Lincoln Center said in March 2023 that Steven R. Swartz, chief executive of Hearst, would succeed Katherine Farley as board chair that June. A director since 2012, he led its Corporate Fund for ten years.
ICP gave its 2010 Infinity Award, the Trustees Award, to Gilbert C. Maurer, a Hearst Corporation board member and a director of The Hearst Foundations.
In an open letter of 19 February 2014, participating artists told the Biennale board that their part in the sponsored event added value to the Transfield brand and lent the company cultural standing.
Viktor Vekselberg chaired the museum's board of trustees. The Jerusalem Post reported in March 2021 that he had given up the post.

France's ambassador conferred the Chevalier de l'Ordre national du Mérite on Sunil Kant Munjal, a November 2025 press release said. Munjal said the honour celebrates "the work we do at Serendipity Arts".

In June 2026 Matt Roberts, executive director of the Conservation Council of WA, said Woodside spends heavily to make itself part of the state's cultural life and named the WA Museum among those it funds.
Artist Adam Bennett wrote in June 2021 that ten nights of protest readings beside the festival's Woodside Pleasure Garden challenged the public acceptance Woodside gains from the sponsorship.
Teresa Heinz, chair emeritus of The Heinz Endowments, is an emeritus member of the museum's advisory board.
Takeo Obayashi, chairman of the board of Obayashi Corporation, sits on the museum's Board of Trustees, as listed in July 2026.
Eli Broad was a life trustee on the museum's board, KPCC reported in March 2013.
Lily Safra, chairwoman of the Edmond J. Safra Philanthropic Foundation, was one of four international Honorary Co-Chairs of the museum's endowment campaign, the museum said in April 2009.

aramco.space_name: King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture (Ithra)

entries.summary: King Salman attended the inauguration ceremony in December 2016, where Aramco chief executive Amin Nasser spoke.

Bénédicte Ficq, lawyer for Fossielvrij NL, said in May 2024 of ING at the Rijksmuseum that the sponsor buys its advertising and legitimises itself through the good name of the institution it sponsors.

Extinction Rebellion accused ING of using art to improve its image and campaigned for the Rijksmuseum to break with it. On 1 March 2025 its supporters reserved thousands of museum tickets and stayed away.

A culture ministry order of 29 July 2024 renewed Antonio Huertas Mejías on the museum's Real Patronato for three years as representative of Mapfre SA. The order opens such seats to contributors to the museum.
Donald Sobey was made a Member of the Order of Canada in 2013. The Governor General's record cites his philanthropy and names his support of the National Gallery of Canada.
Donald Sobey chaired the gallery's board of trustees from 2002 to 2008 and sat on the board of the gallery's foundation from 2007 to 2020.
Rob Sobey, chairman of the Sobey Art Foundation, was appointed to the Order of Nova Scotia in 2024. The citation names his role as past chairman of the Art Gallery of Nova Scotia.

The April 2019 letter “Kanders Must Go”, signed by over 120 scholars and critics, said institutions like the Whitney shield people like Kanders from criticism and called for a debate on art used for reputation.
A Letzte Generation activist who glued himself to the Klimt in November 2022 said fossil firms such as OMV use arts sponsorship to give themselves a good image.
In Vienna for the Opera Ball in February 2023, Jane Fonda said fossil fuel firms give money to museums and operas to win public approval and was sorry to learn OMV sponsors the opera.
James Hughes-Hallett, who joined the Swire Group in 1976 and chaired several of its branches from 1999 to 2015, was a trustee of the gallery from 2005 to 2013.
Alan Joyce, then chief executive of the Qantas Group, joined the museum's board of directors in September 2019.
In November 2025 Osman Gece wrote in soL's Ortaklaşa, in a piece on the 18th Biennial and its sponsor, that Koç Holding deliberately uses the language of art as a legitimacy shield for its class.

lassonde.space_name: Musée national des beaux-arts du Québec

entries.summary: Pierre Lassonde joined the museum's board in 2005 and was its chair by 2016.
Pierre Lassonde was received as a Grand Québécois of the cultural sector in 2016. The citation credits his contribution to financing the museum's new pavilion.
Pierre Lassonde was promoted to Officer of the Order of Canada in 2022. The citation names his donations to institutions in the arts and education and the administrative expertise he lent the museum.

Business/Arts gave Pierre Lassonde its Edmund C. Bovey Award in October 2023 for a lifetime commitment to arts philanthropy. The Globe and Mail's report lists the museum's $110 million fundraising campaign among his contributions.

Trustees Jo Foster and Hannah Fry resigned in November 2021 after the museum partnered with Adani Green Energy. Fry wrote in The Times that such ties wrongly suggest fossil fuel companies are doing enough.

Joanna Haigh, former co-director of the Grantham Institute, told The Art Newspaper in March 2023 the deal was a plain case of greenwashing that let the company gain respectability from its link to the museum.
More than 150 people occupied the museum in March 2024, days before the gallery opened. Mukti Shah of South Asia Solidarity Group said the museum was helping the corporation present itself as green.
In 2023 the French ambassador Emmanuel Lenain made Kiran Nadar a Chevalier of the Légion d'honneur for her work in art. Eastern Eye's report credits her role as chairperson of the museum.
Kiran Nadar received India's Padma Shri in 2024. The official citation opens with her as founder and chairperson of the museum and credits her guidance of it since 2010.

fundacincostantini.space_name: Museo de Arte Latinoamericano de Buenos Aires (MALBA)

entries.summary: Queen Sofía handed Eduardo Costantini the Premio Internacional de Mecenazgo in Madrid in March 2025. The jury's ruling said the museum he created has become a world reference.

Argentina's culture secretary Leonardo Cifelli handed Eduardo Costantini the distinction of Personalidad Emérita de la Cultura de la Nación in September 2025 and stressed Malba's role as an international reference.

chartwelltrust.space_name: Auckland Art Gallery Toi o Tāmaki

entries.summary: The trust received the 2011 Arts Foundation of New Zealand Award for Patronage at a ceremony held in the gallery. The event also celebrated the new Chartwell Gallery there.

The Hispanic Society of America gave its Sorolla Medal in November 2023 to Fernando Zobel de Ayala and his family for arts advocacy through the Ayala Foundation. He chairs the museum's board of advisers.

Hiroshi Ishibashi, chairman of the Ishibashi Foundation and director of the museum, received the 2023 Red Dot Personality Prize for design, given in part for the Artizon Museum's achievements in recent years.
Forbes Asia named Abhishek Poddar in its 2018 Heroes of Philanthropy list for his family's gift of money and works from their collection to the museum.

Nadja Swarovski, a member of the Swarovski executive board, co-hosted the 2017 Art Icon gala dinner at the gallery with director Iwona Blazwick and sat on the committee that chose Peter Doig for the award.

Asher Gamedze and Mitchel Hunter, in the Mail & Guardian in April 2018, cited Nathan Kirsh's Magal Security Systems holding and asked whether Black artists at A4 were used to make occupation profits look acceptable.
STIR named Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw, the founder of Biocon, as a board member of MAP in its January 2023 report on the museum's inauguration.
The Frick honoured Stephen Schwarzman at its 2019 Autumn Dinner, where director Ian Wardropper toasted him and he received a commemorative silver tray.

An open letter of 27 May 2026, signed by over 100 art professionals including Ali Cherri and Dominique Gonzalez-Foerster, said the Centre Pompidou partnership uses art to improve Hanwha's image and asked for its end.
Amorepacific won the Korea Mécénat Association's Mécénat Award in November 2021. The company says the award also recognises its support of the Amorepacific Museum of Art.

France's consul general in Shanghai gave Budi Tek the Legion of Honour at the Yuz Museum in August 2017. China Daily said he received it for the museum's dialogue between Chinese and Western cultures.
Carnegie Hall's board elected Ronald Perelman chairman on 19 February 2015. He had been a trustee since 1988 and a vice chairman since 2012.
In June 2025 French ambassador Michel Miraillet made Ellen Remai a Knight of the Order of Arts and Letters at Remai Modern, citing her support of the arts and her donation of Picasso linocuts.
Simon Mordant was made an Officer of the Order of Australia in June 2020 for service to visual arts and philanthropy. The Sydney Morning Herald cited his MCA chair and gift to its new wing.

gibbs.space_name: Auckland Art Gallery Toi o Tāmaki

entries.summary: Jenny Gibbs received Auckland City's second Distinguished Citizen Award in February 2004. The citation said she uses her influence to help Auckland Art Gallery.
Jenny Gibbs was made a Dame Companion of the New Zealand Order of Merit in 2009 for services to the arts. The New Zealand Herald listed first her help buying Auckland Art Gallery's New Gallery.
Michael Lee-Chin is a director on the ROM Board of Governors, the board that manages the museum's endowments and capital funds.
In January 2020 the academics Delinda Collier and Marissa Moorman wrote in Africa Is a Country that Dokolo's patronage of African artists and his repatriation efforts improve his public image.

In January 1991 the Time critic Robert Hughes called it the most vain museum in America, paid for by Occidental's shareholders, and wrote that Hammer toured his collection worldwide to promote Occidental and himself.
Mexico's President Felipe Calderón attended the opening of the museum on 1 March 2011 and spoke after Carlos Slim.
